item.title: Why a WNBA team is consulting national security experts
item.description: As WNBA popularity grows, so do threats and abuse toward players. One team is adopting an unusual strategy by bringing in national security specialists.

item.title: Nation honors Dolly Parton's life in Nashville and beyond
item.description: Following Dolly Parton's death earlier this week, tributes have flowed nationwide. Fans are grieving the loss of a country music legend and cultural icon.

item.title: Trump announces U.S. deal with Venezuela for control of 65 billion barrels of oil
item.description: President Trump said his administration reached a broad agreement with Venezuela that may grant the U.S. access to substantial oil reserves in the region.
